modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: organize work as per the organization’s health, safety and security policies and procedures
identify the risks and hazards associated while driving and their causes and preventions
check and ensure the functioning of vehicle before commencing work
identify and report vehicle maintenance and repair requirements/risks as per SOP, if any
take corrective measures and follow standard first-aid procedures in case of an accident
ensure safety of all passengers and immediately report any breaches to the appropriate authority
ensure vehicle and equipment are regularly cleaned and sanitized
wash hands with soap and use alcohol-based sanitizer regularly
avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
wear and dispose of PPEs regularly and appropriately
report hygiene and sanitation issues to appropriate authority, if any
follow processes specified for disposal of hazardous waste
identify ways to optimize usage of fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) in the vehicle
use resources in a responsible manner
check for spills/leakages in the vehicle with caution
plug spills/leakages of fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG), oil/coolant or water from the vehicle and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
report malfunctioning (fumes/sparks/emission/vibration/noise) and lapse in maintenance of the vehicle
ensure the various equipment of the vehicle is properly connected

modules.module_title: Examine the vehicle before the trip

pcs.pc_description: inspect and conform the vehicle’s condition as per health and safety guidelines before starting the trip
ensure the vehicle meets the legal and compliance requirements like pollution test, load limit, etc.
perform routine maintenance checks on the vehicle for tyre pressure, fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) level, working of headlights and brakes, CNG cylinder valves etc.
check vehicle service record for any history of technical defects or immediate need for servicing like oil/filter change, etc.
prepare a to-do list for repair requirement, if any
record all deviations observed while carrying out checks
report actual or potential defects/deviations to the senior driver/owner/service supervisor
determine roadworthiness of the vehicle and use another vehicle if the current vehicle is found unfit
confirm all gauges and warning lights are functioning properly before moving the vehicle

modules.module_title: Drive the LMV conforming to the standard driving practices

pcs.pc_description: perform pre-driving activities like shoulder checking, adjusting IRVM/ ORVM and releasing of handbrakes, etc.
insert or press the ignition key/button to start the vehicle
coordinate gear changes, if any, with appropriate use of clutch/acceleration and steering control
maneuver the vehicle safely and responsibly while regulating the speed in all weather and road conditions by coordinating the operation of all controls
use the accelerator, steering control and brakes correctly for safe driving, stopping and parking the vehicle
ensure maximum fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) efficiency while driving
follow guidelines on the road while driving like avoiding excessive honking, driving on high beam, loud music, etc.
maintain a safe distance from other vehicles
ensure the vehicle is within the prescribed speed limits at all times and avoid rod hog
ensure proper parking at appropriate spots
adhere to local and state specific driving laws and traffic regulations, including overloading
turn off ignition at red lights or after parking the vehicle to enhance fuel efficiency
monitor and respond correctly to gauges, warning lights, CNG leakage etc. while driving
ensure to stop the vehicle at a safe place in case of any malfunction and turn off the ignition
carry out a quick diagnostic check
carry out minor adjustments or temporary repairs like replacement/top-up of oil, change of tyres/wipers, etc. if possible
report the exact nature of the problem to the supervisor to get appropriate help from the command office
take the vehicle to the service point for corrective action in case of major defect or accident

pcs.pc_description: check the forklift for engine oil level, fuel level, radiator water level (LPG, gas and diesel forklifts)

inspect the battery area visually for spillage and corrosion on terminals/battery tray and ensure the battery plug connections are not loose, terminals are greased, and voltage and vent caps are not clogged (battery operated FLT’s)
check all the cables for exposed wires
monitor the electrolyte levels in cells and hold-downs or brackets to keep the battery securely in a place
make sure guards, chains, or hydraulic hose reels are not damaged and bolts/ nuts are intact
check wheels and tyres for wear, damage, and air pressure (in case of pneumatic tyres)
ensure forks are not bent, no cracks are present, positioning latches are in good working condition, and carriage teeth are not broken, chipped, or worn
make sure the overhead cage is in good condition and does not have any cracks, bend, etc.
ensure the horn is working and loud enough to be heard in the working environment and other warning devices are operational
check headlights and warning lights for proper functioning

modules.module_title: Perform basic operational check before the start of work

pcs.pc_description: ensure that the pedal of the foot break holds and the unit stops smoothly
make sure the parking brake holds against slight acceleration
confirm that the seat brake holds when operator rises from the seat
make sure the clutch and gearshift shift smoothly with no jumping or jerking
check dash control panel for proper functioning of all lights and gauges
examine the emergency switch for proper functioning (if available),
make sure the steering and lift and tilt mechanism works smoothly examine cylinders and hoses should for leakage
examine cylinders and hoses for any leakage
ensure the mast tilts forward and backward correctly and also extends
make sure forklift preventive maintenance schedules are followed as per standard guidelines

pcs.pc_description: fasten the seatbelt and wear other PPE like hard hat as per OSHA (Occupation Safety and Health Act)
check the parking brake for engagement
confirm that the transmission control lever is in a neutral position, safety locks are on (if fitted) and all attachment controls are in the neutral position
make sure that the throttle control or accelerator pedal is pushed past any constriction that may be fitted and is in the low idle position
start the engine as per specified instructions
cool down the starter or pre-heat the vehicle as required, if engine fails to start within approximately 10 seconds
check all gauges for correct operation
allow the engine and components to warm up to operating temperature (for approximately 5 minutes) before the operation
check all attachment controls for their correct operation, unusual noises and any vibrations after starting the forklift
ensure that the area is clear and it is safe to move the forklift
drive the forklift near the storage location where the material is kept
lower the forks while keeping the mast in upright condition if load is kept on ground or take it to the level of load
align the fork before inserting it into the pallet
insert the fork all the way under the material
adjust the fork as wide as possible to fit the load and to provide a more even distribution of weight
ensure the load is within specified limits of forklift
make sure that the material on pallets is stable, neat, cross-tied and evenly distributed
tilt loads backward or as specified for load
travel with forks as low as possible from the floor and tilted back
match speed of driving with load and workplace conditions
drive to the designated location through the specified aisles/bin/location as per safety norms
make sure not to meet with any obstacles as in the unladen condition the FLT balance in rear might be heavy
rest the pallet on ground/bin base and slowly start removing forks out of the pallet as per instructions
ensure the safe and efficient transport of delicate or hazardous items such as fragile goods, chemicals, or equipment that require precise handling to avoid damage, contamination, or accidents
ensure that the material is not damaged while unloading

modules.module_title: Park the forklift after daily operations

pcs.pc_description: park the forklift in the parking area with the forks and attachments (if any) touching the ground after unloading the material
place all attachment control levers in the neutral or hold position
tighten all lift chains as they may jump clear of the top carrier rollers
place the transmission and forward-reverse levers into the neutral position and apply safety locks and brakes
turn off the fuel isolating valve, in case of an LPG powered forklift
switch off the ignition
decrease the inner pressure by operating the lift & tilting lever several times
take out the key & hand it over to concerned person as per the organizational policy

modules.module_title: Park the forklift for long durations

pcs.pc_description: park the forklift in the shade or location specified for long duration parking
take out the plug to prevent discharge of batteries (both electric or other fuel)
apply anti-rust on exposed parts like piston rod
add oil/grease to all the lubrication points, as required
operate forklift once in a week with forks lifted till its maximum heigh
check battery once a month if it is parked for months
